raw: I went to the Cup Noodles Ramen Museum to learn all about instant noodles from their invention in 1958 to how they ended up in space.
actually: I visited the Cup Noodles Ramen Museum to learn the history of instant noodles, from their invention in 1958 to their use in space.

raw: Then hit the cafeteria where you can try noodle-based dishes from all around the world.
actually: Then visit the cafeteria to try noodle dishes from different countries.

raw: Malaysia, Indonesia, Vietnam, all in one spot.
actually: Dishes from Malaysia, Indonesia, and Vietnam are available in one place.

raw: Best part, you can make your own custom cup ramen.
actually: A highlight is the opportunity to make your own customized cup ramen.

raw: I chose a curry base with cheese, egg, mystery meat, and crab.
actually: I selected a curry base with cheese, egg, unidentified meat, and crab.

raw: So if you want to know more about cup noodles, come visit
actually: Visit if you would like to learn more about cup noodles.
